title: Website canvas touch controls and Network live-source discovery remain usable

source.ref: Block editor maturity audit 2026-10-15; hover-only insert labels and undersized touch handles; Network live metadata missing

detail: The Frequency canvas previously made insert labels transparent until hover or focus, leaving touch users without a visible insertion affordance. Coarse-pointer insertion now has a persistent theme-token treatment; typography, nested layout handles, section labels and chrome editing provide 44px touch targets, and spacing handles gain a transparent 44px hit region. NetworkHero, NetworkEvents and NetworkCircles read actual Space events/community but the editor previously called them Editable. They now join the Live group and expose the existing live-source guidance; authored Network blocks remain authored. Focused metadata/picker and iframe interaction regressions pass. Physical touch-device visual verification remains outstanding; no public renderer or global theme sheet changed.
